title: Grandmaster of Demonic Cultivation
author: Mo Xiang Tong Xiu
description: Revived in the body of a lunatic after years of infamy, the dreaded founder of demonic cultivation Wei Wuxian reunites with his former classmate Lan Wangji. Together, they embark on a supernatural journey to untangle a web of dark mysteries, unearthing buried secrets and a profound bond along the way.
